notes:
eval-pilot lint checks these rules:

Rule	Level	Fires when
E1	error	A decision has no warrant path to a MUST or SHOULD criterion (when intent exists)
E2	error	RECONSTRUCTED or PROMPT_ONLY intent excuses a deviation of MATERIAL or worse
E2w	warning	CONTEMPORANEOUS intent excuses a deviation of MATERIAL or worse
E3	error	Evidence falls outside the decoded timeline
E4	error	A relation kind or purpose is outside the vocabulary
E5	error	A resolution, or an upward confidence revision, rests only on DISCOVERY evidence
E6	error	A frozen test plan fails frozen_digest verification
E7	error	An override has no reason
W1	warning	A motion claim is supported only by still frames
W2	warning	A hand-built exhaustive set has no residual
W3	warning	A hypothesis has no alternative
W4	warning	A stochastic arm has no sample design or decision rule
W5	warning	A relation's purpose is UNSPECIFIED

Appended acceptance:
- Every lint rule declares all evidence fields it requires, and every prerequisite passes through one shared evidence-availability boundary before it may support a clean rule result.
- The shared evidence boundary returns AVAILABLE(value), UNKNOWN(reason) for missing, null or unavailable evidence, or INTEGRITY_FAILURE(reason) for malformed, wrong-type, impossible, corrupt or integrity-invalid evidence. Do not introduce a new INVALID vocabulary.
- Only AVAILABLE may support a clean rule result. UNKNOWN and INTEGRITY_FAILURE each produce an explicit diagnostic and make the result incomplete/not-ready; neither can produce PASS, COMPLETE, SHIP, ready=true or an equivalent clean state.
- One shared parameterized evidence contract test covers every declared prerequisite of every lint rule with missing, null, malformed/wrong-type where representable, and a valid boundary value. Where ordinary admission prevents malformed values, test the raw/read-only path that encounters corrupt retained data.
- Regressions cover null and invalid motion dimensions and null and invalid decoded durations with full-clip evidence, through direct and retained-query paths, with explicit diagnostics and ready=false; valid non-motion context remains supported.
- Use the existing split mechanism if L12 cannot fit the configured 900 changed-line budget. Never remove, loosen or reduce tests to fit.
